messages:

Date: 2027-06-12 07:12 +02:00
Subject: EU-only hosting + SCCs: initial ask

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the meeting earlier. To make sure we get the procurement packet right for Medicorp, can you confirm three things so our security team can prepare the evidence bundle: 

1) EU-only processing requirement: do you require all inference, logging, and backups to remain in EU regions (no transient processing in other regions)?
2) SCCs scope: are you expecting the standard EU Commission SCCs document only, or do you want an appendix describing restricted access to KMS keys and contact points for lawful intercept?
3) Deletion and retention: is the retention policy 90 days for logs and 365 days for backups, or do you have a different requirement?

I'll assemble the data flow diagram and a draft SCCs supplement. If you prefer, we can do a quick follow-up call with legal (15–20 minutes).

Attaching: initial data-flow diagram (placeholder).

Thanks,
Marcus

marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Anna Vogel <anna.vogel@medicorp.de>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medicorp.de>, legal@medicorp.de
Date: 2027-06-12 09:44 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only hosting + SCCs: initial ask

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for sending this through and for the clear summary. Quick answers inline: 

1) EU-only: yes — all inference, KV caches, logs and backups must reside and be processed only in EU territories. We allow temporary worker orchestration outside EU only if no customer data ever leaves region (we'd need architecture proof).
2) SCCs: we require the standard SCCs plus a short supplement describing where customer-managed keys are allowed (we use AWS KMS in eu-central-1) and the contact for lawful access requests. A signed supplement is preferable but not mandatory up-front.
3) Retention: logs 90 days, backups 1 year. Deletion evidence must include API call audit showing deletion and retention config snapshots.

I'll have procurement attach our standard questionnaire (see attached Excel). We're aiming to close the procurement review next week, so a handoff of evidence by Friday would be ideal.

Best,
Anna
Head of IT Compliance | Medicorp GmbH
anna.vogel@medicorp.de | +49 30 5556 900

Attachment: Medicorp_SCCS_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

Folks —

Thanks, Marcus and Anna. Action items for Redwood to produce the evidence bundle Medicorp requested: 

- Marcus: produce an architecture/data-flow diagram called out by region and show where KMS keys live (deadline: 2027-06-13 EOD).
- Soojin: prepare the SCCs supplement language that clarifies Redwood-managed vs customer-managed KMS, and our standard lawful access contact flow (deadline: 2027-06-13 noon).
- Neha (Security): export a sample deletion audit (sanitized) and a snapshot of retention settings for logs/backups. Confirm whether we can provide API logs in redacted format. (deadline: 2027-06-13 EOD).

We should keep the bundle lightweight: one pdf with redwood-data-flow-diagram.png embedded, the completed Medicorp_SCCS_Questionnaire.xlsx, and a one-page supplement (signed-sccs-draft.pdf). Please mark any items that need legal review before share.

I'll coordinate packaging and the DocuSign link. Marcus — please loop me in once you have the diagram so I can do a quick quality check.

Laura Bennett

Attached is the evidence bundle we discussed: 
- signed-sccs-draft.pdf (one-page supplement; pending legal review)
- Medicorp_SCCS_Questionnaire.xlsx (completed where Redwood can answer; items in column D need your confirmation)
- redwood-data-flow-diagram.png (annotated: shows eu-central-1 as the only region for processing, outlines KMS key ownership options)

Key notes: 
- KMS: we support both Redwood-managed KMS (keys in eu-central-1, restricted admin role) and customer-managed KMS (you retain key control in your account). The supplement describes the key handover model and replay-protection we use for ephemeral keys.
- Deletion evidence: included is a redacted sample API audit showing a deletion request and subsequent object removal. We can provide the full retention-config snapshot under NDA if needed.
- SCCs: the draft supplement references the EU Commission SCCs and adds an appendix on lawful access flows; legal has preliminarily reviewed but requests a signature line for Medicorp legal.

Next steps: please confirm by EOD whether this bundle satisfies procurement. If yes, I will send the DocuSign link for the supplement and coordinate a 15-min call to walk legal through the KMS section.

Thanks,
